cohort: The study participants were 13 patients diagnosed with early cesarean scar pregnancy at Suleymaniye Maternity Hospital in Istanbul, Turkey, over a 4-year period.
finding: Surgical evacuation using suction curettage under ultrasound guidance with Foley balloon tamponade was a safe and successful first-line treatment in all 13 carefully selected patients with early cesarean scar pregnancy, with no major complications.
gest_age: Early pregnancy (mean gestational sac diameter 13.65 mm, range 7.6-27 mm)
